script_text: Stop! Pisces, the cosmic waves are crashing hard right now. This alignment amplifies your intuition and draws opportunities through partnerships. If you're single, a deep soul-level connection could spark from an honest conversation—lean into vulnerability. If taken, your partner senses your inner turmoil; share your fears before they widen. Financially, Mercury in your 8th House warns against impulsive investments or shared expenses—pause before signing anything. Avoid escaping into fantasy when practical decisions arise; ground yourself through meditation instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what the stars reveal next.
